exposure: Girl2Girl text messaging-based pregnancy prevention program
outcome: uptake of other types of birth control
cohort: A total of 948 cisgender LGB+ girls, 14-18 years old, were recruited nationally.
finding: The Girl2Girl program showed significant moderating effects of age, sexual identity, and sexual experience on rates of condom use and use of other contraception, being particularly effective for older adolescents, bisexual girls, and those who had already had penile-vaginal sex.
